query: At about what age do adults normally begin to lose bone mass?
passage: In adults, this occurs at a rate of about 10% each year. This is a natural process to ensure maintenance of normal bone mass as a person ages. Normal bone mass indicates healthy bones that are free of problems such as osteoporosis. The remodeling cycle usually starts when injury or mechanical stresses occur in bones.
